question: what is the percentage change in the unamortized debt issuance costs associated with the senior notes from 2016 to 2017?
reasoning: We need percentage change in unamortized debt issuance costs associated with senior notes from 2016 to 2017. From Note 14: "The Company had unamortized debt issuance costs associated with the senior notes of $15 million and $19 million as of December 31, 2017 and 2016, respectively." So 2017=15, 2016=19. Percentage change = (15-19)/19 = -4/19 ≈ -21.0526%. Need answer as percentage. Provide evidence and program.
raw_content:
<evidence>
$15 million | Note 14: Debt - unamortized debt issuance costs associated with senior notes as of December 31, 2017
$19 million | Note 14: Debt - unamortized debt issuance costs associated with senior notes as of December 31, 2016
</evidence>
<program>divide(subtract(15, 19), 19)</program>
<answer>-21.0526%</answer>
